limitations: Scripted policies on seeded, planted traps: evidence about these policies on these cases, not about any model's readiness for production.
v2's test generators were scored before (BEN-002 to BEN-005); v3 reseeds them, but only the rare bases are new to every rule.
A leak counts as caught when the column is kept out of the model; the reason given is not checked. Partial labels count as caught when the solution says labels are partial.
Cases built from one base share its columns and its generator: they are not independent of each other.
